whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: on a silent Sunday the recap goes as its own text at 6 pm.
shouldHaveHappened: At 6 pm ZOH starts a text: opens with Sam's name, a warm line, 2 to 4 pieces of progress from this week each backed by what happened (3 minutes without stopping on Saturday; the talk-test pace, used and recalled since Tuesday; all 6 runs done, 5 in full and 1 smaller), never framed as 'what you couldn't do before', no report headings or 'streak' as the headline. It says where he stands vs. the mile by Nov 14 (about a mile covered with walk breaks, 3 min straight so far) and ends with one question about the week. The shin lesson was only explained: not claimed as understood. No proof ask, nothing about today's step (it's a rest day). His replies lead into the week talk, which ends with Monday's step fully defined (e.g. 4 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds around the block at talk-test pace, 6:30 pm, about 15 min), asked if it works. After 'perfect' a short confirmation, no new question.
